summary: Pampa Energia S.A., an Argentine electric utility, furnished a Form 6-K to the SEC containing unaudited consolidated condensed interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026, prepared in accordance with IFRS and reviewed by Price Waterhouse Co. S.R.L. This is a routine periodic financial reporting filing, equivalent to a quarterly report in the US, with no special situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring disclosed. The filing is informational only and does not trigger any special-situations analysis; no deal terms or strategic actions are present.
